verdict.rationale: Helicone's docs say you can 'track usage, costs, and performance across all providers in one dashboard,' and requests appear in a Requests tab. Community users confirm they can see per-request cost and charts, and contrast this with OpenAI's daily-total-only view. missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-model and per-time-period breakdowns, explicit mention of token-count metrics in dashboards, in-depth first-party dashboard docs.
